# Puzzle Lantern

> Puzzle Lantern is a mobile collection of daily puzzle games. Every game has
> one Daily puzzle: the same grid, the same pattern and the same words for
> everyone playing that day. There is no signup form and no password, and the
> app never asks for access to your contacts. Made for entertainment, and
> nothing more is claimed for it.

Last updated: 17 September 2026.

## The games

Four games ship today. Each one is a self-contained module, and new games join
the collection over time.

- **Sudoku** (logic). A complete classic 9x9 grid, not a mini version. Pencil
  marks, unlimited undo, hints, and mistake highlighting you can switch off.
  Daily runs at the generator's Easy setting. More puzzles is unlimited on
  Easy, Medium, Hard or Expert. Ranked on completed without hints, then
  completed with hints, then fewer mistakes, then fewer hints, then time.
- **Recall** (memory). A pattern of marked cells is shown briefly, then
  recreated on a blank grid. The Daily is eight seeded escalating rounds and
  ends on the eighth round or the third strike. More puzzles is endless on a
  gentler curve.
- **Vanish** (memory). A hand of playing cards is shown, then re-shown with one
  card gone; you name the vanished card from a line-up of five. Eight rounds on
  the Daily, the hand growing every second round, three misses ends it. More
  puzzles is endless on Easy, Medium or Hard.
- **Word Sense** (word). Three words a day, one easy, one medium and one hard,
  each named from a sentence it has been cut out of. Five clues per word from a
  six-rung catalogue. A wrong guess costs a clue at the same price as asking.
  Daily only: there is no More puzzles mode. Ranked on solved words weighted by
  tier, then unspent clues. Time is not part of the ranking.

## How it works

- One Daily puzzle per game per day, identical for every player on that date.
  Puzzle dates roll over at local midnight.
- No archive. Yesterday's puzzle is gone.
- No daily checklist, no combined score across games and nothing to complete.
  One overall activity streak, kept alive by any single Daily.
- No signup screen. An account is created on first launch with a generated
  username. No email address and no password.
- Friends are added by invite link or by a request to an exact username, and
  both need the other person to accept. No search, no friend codes, no contact
  syncing.
- Play works offline and syncs when connectivity returns.

## Access and cost

- A new installation plays free for seven days, with no card, no account and no
  store interaction.
- After that it needs a subscription.
- Installations from before the first paid release stay free permanently.
- No third-party advertisements and no advertising identifiers, anywhere.
- Hints are not sold for money. In Sudoku they cost rank instead.

## Platforms

- iOS: live on the App Store as "Puzzle Lantern: Daily Games", app id
  6804652103, since 11 September 2026.
- Android: the project is written but not published.

## What is deliberately not claimed

Puzzle Lantern is an entertainment product. No claim is made, anywhere, that
playing it sharpens or protects the brain, improves intelligence, memory,
language ability or cognitive health, prevents or delays any condition, or
produces any benefit outside the games themselves. Game and category names
describe what you do in the game, not an effect on you, and no result in it is
a measurement of anyone's abilities.

## Known limits

- Account recovery is unbuilt, so an account cannot move between devices or
  survive deleting the app.
- The first launch of a fresh install with no network cannot establish access.
- There is no crossword, no Connections-style grouping game and no Spelling Bee
  equivalent.
